name: Cantus
source:
Interest: Seas & Seashells

Originally, I planned to let the entire [url=https://vndb.org/v14646]Voices from the Sea[/url] cast appear as faceless characters. However, I was tempted with the idea of drawing a grown-up Cantus, and that is how I ended up drawing the entire cast. I regret nothing.
